Cinematic live-action scene, shot on film. A lone courier in a dark raincoat rides a bicycle across a wet city bridge at dusk, neon signs reflecting in the puddles, slow tracking shot from the side, shallow depth of field, realistic physics, restrained colour grading.
Timeline: [0s-2s] the rider enters from the left, wheels throwing spray; [2s-4s] the camera moves alongside as the rider pedals harder; [4s-5s] the rider passes a bright sign and disappears into the fog.
Audio: steady tire hiss, distant traffic, low ambient synth, a soft swell at the end. No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark.
